text:
Noah (Sales): Heads-up: VegaFin POC tomorrow. Requirements: on-prem SCIM gateway (air-gapped), support for two IdPs per tenant (Okta + AzureAD), delegated domain-scoped admins, RBAC -> internal entitlement codes, and a security questionnaire. They also want a quick Dedicated+Private ballpark.
Ivy (SE): Quick Qs: expected users? sync cadence? need nested groups?
Noah (Sales): ~95k users, daily delta + JIT for contractors, nested groups used for team hierarchies, need bulk export for audits.
Rahul (Infra): For air-gapped SCIM we ship a local gateway that speaks mTLS to the control plane or can run fully offline writing to our on-prem cache. Use incremental change tokens + pagination. Recommend 180 req/s headroom during sync; include cert rotation agent (90d default).
Tara (Security): I'll pick up the questionnaire. We support customer KMS for Private, SOC2 info available. Need product to confirm erase-on-decom timelines and default log retention.
Ivy (SE): RBAC approach: SCIM custom extension for entitlement codes and mapping table in gateway. Delegated admins mapped via SCIM group roles (scopes: invite.users, manage.groups). Will prepare schema example.
Noah (Sales): Ballpark pricing to share: Reserved Dedicated = $38k/mo, Private license = $140k one-time, on-site install & validation = $11k one-time, premium connectors + SLA = $4k/mo. Call it preliminary.
Rahul (Infra): Action: write install checklist + cert rotation script + test dataset (15k users) for POC.
Ivy (SE): Action: post SCIM mapping example + note on nested groups and backoff behavior.
Tara (Security): Action: start questionnaire draft and KMS/HSM options.
Noah (Sales): I'll send the ballpark and confirm kickoff time with VegaFin.
